data.title: Authority Expands Services as Visitor Numbers Rise at Prophet's Mosque
data.content:
Madinah, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Visitors from across the Kingdom and Umrah performers of various nationalities continue to arrive at the Prophet's Mosque, supported by a range of services provided by the General Authority for the Care of the Affairs of the Grand Mosque and the Prophet's Mosque, in cooperation with relevant entities, to help them perform their rituals with ease.
    The authority is responding to the high number of worshippers by providing additional copies of the Holy Quran and Zamzam water, operating cooling systems, shaded canopies, and mist fans in the courtyards to ease the heat, and expanding religious and directional guidance services. It also answers inquiries and assists elderly people and persons with disabilities as part of integrated services aimed at facilitating and enriching the visitor experience.
    These efforts reflect the authority's commitment to improving the quality of services provided to worshippers and Umrah performers visiting the Prophet's Mosque and facilitating their worship in an atmosphere of comfort and tranquility.
    
    -- SPA
15:16 Local Time 12:16 GMT
